Properties.PropertyDesc: For legal entities the code should be a valid LEI. For entities without LEI codes the use of RIAD codes is encouraged. If an LEI or RIAD code is not available,	another unique code should be provided by the CA.  For banking groups and liquidity subgroups,	the parent company 'Entity Code' should be used,	if a parent company exists,	otherwise another unique code should be provided. Best practice is to start the non-LEI codes with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country of residence of the entity. This property together with ‘Entity Type’ will form the unique identifier for reporting.
Properties.PropertyHelpDesc: For legal entities the code should be a valid LEI.

Properties.PropertyDesc: Determines whether the code provided in the 'Entity Code' property is an LEI code or not.

Properties.PropertyHelpDesc: Main code used in NCAs credit registers to identify a credit institution/branch.

Properties.PropertyDesc: Entity name in Latin alphabet. For individual entities this should be the official name as per authorisation of activity (if applicable). For groups the name shall be the one recorded in the NCA’s system, otherwise the one for the parent company. For entities where the official name is not in a Latin based alphabet a transcription into Latin characters should be provided as this property is only based in Latin alphabet,	for harmonisation purposes. Multiple values should be allowed for CRD credit institutions and branches in countries with more than one official national language (e.g. Belgium, Luxembourg). In that case all official names, as per authorisation, shall be recorded (names will be submitted in different/multiple lines) this property will be published in the EBA website in CIR.
Properties.PropertyHelpDesc: Entity name in Latin alphabet.

Properties.PropertyHelpDesc: Institution name in Non-Latin alphabet.

Properties.PropertyLabel: Type of Undertaking According to CRR Article 27
Properties.PropertyDesc: This information is requested to identify the undertakings that may qualify as a mutual, cooperative society, savings institutions or similar institution for the purposes of art. 27 (1) (a) of the CRR. Each category (“mutual”, “cooperative society”, “savings institution” “similar institution”) are further detailed in Subsection 2 of the RTS on Own Funds (241/2014). For more information regarding subparagraph 27(1)(a)(v) please consult the CRR. The category “Not Applicable” refers to all institution that do not fall under one of the categories explicitly mentioned in Article 27 (1)(a) of the CRR (e.g. 'joint stock companies').
Properties.PropertyShortDesc: Type of Undertaking According to CRR Article 27
Properties.PropertyHelpDesc:
This information is requested to identify the undertakings that may qualify as a mutual, cooperative society, savings institutions or similar institution for the purposes of art. 27
 (1) (a) of the CRR. Each category (“mutual”, “cooperative society”, “savings institution” “similar institution”) are further detailed in Subsection 2 of the RTS on Own Funds (241/2014). 
 For more information regarding subparagraph 27(1)(a)(v) please consult the CRR. 
 The category “Not Applicable” refers to all institution that do not fall under one of the categories explicitly mentioned in Article 27 (1)(a) of the CRR (e.g. 'joint stock companies').

Properties.PropertyDesc: Town of Residence. For CRD credit institutions should be reported the head office or the registered office (preferably the first but there is flexibility and it is left for the CA to perform this assessment). Regarding branches,	this should be the town where the firm's principal place of business is located (in the host Member State),	or the town "...from which documents may be obtained" (Articles 35 (2) c) & 38 CRD), whatever is available in the NCA’s register. Regarding the language to be provided it should be name in national language(s) (or one of the official national languages), but if a common English name of the town exists it can be used as well. Therefore,	multiple entries are allowed. If name is not in a Latin based alphabet,	then transcription of the name into Latin characters should be provided (if it is available for the CA), while the official name in Non-Latin characters should be reported under property 'Town of Residence Non Latin'.
Properties.PropertyHelpDesc: Town of Residence. For CRD credit institutions should be reported the head office or the registered office

Properties.PropertyDesc: EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme(s). To be reported by CRD Credit institutions and branches (EEA and Non-EEA) that have a DGS in the host EEA country. For EEA branches it should be reported only the DGS of the host member state (if possible under National Law of host member state). The information regarding the DGS of the credit institution establishing the branch will be derived. For non-EEA branches this should be the EEA host DGS in case of no equivalence as per art. 15 DGSD. In case of equivalence, it means the Non-EEA branch is covered by a third country and therefore that Non-EEA DGS should be reported in property 'Non-EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme'. Please note that even in case of equivalence,	it might be possible/required under National Law of Host MS that the branch is also covered by a local EEA DGS,	in this case then the EEA DGS must also be reported in property 'EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme(s)'.

Values.CodeDescription: CRD Credit Institution – as defined in point (1) of Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013;

EEA Branch of CRD Credit Institution -  as defined in point (17) of Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013  - means a place of business which forms a legally dependent part of an CRD Credit Institution and which carries out directly all or some of the transactions inherent in the business of CRD Credit Institutions;
Branch of non-EEA Credit Institution - branches of Credit Institutions having their head office in a third country (Article 47 of the CRD).
Notional Entity –  Non-Legal Entity which cannot have an LEI Code or is established solely for supervisory reporting purposes
Central Body –  as referred to in Article 10 of the CRR;
Investment Firm – as defined in point (2) of Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 - which refers to MiFID II (Directive 2014/65/EU);
Liquidity Subgroup – as defined in Article 8 of the CRR;

Entity Code Type [NON_LEI]:- Not  a Legal Entity Identifier Code Type (Not in GLEIF):- The code provided in the 'Entity Code' property is not an LEI code

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: All Entity Properties to support Entity Level Operations.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: All Entity Properties

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Code to specify the type of entity and in case of groups the level of consolidation. This property together with 'Entity Code' will form the unique identifier for reporting supervisory data. Only one value may be chosen. Master data for investment firms will only be collected for the investment firms in the Remuneration sample. EntityTypes code values and descriptions are defined in the EntityType tables
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc:
The register only includes credit institutions classified in three different types:
1. 'CRD credit institutions' : legally defined as ‘an undertaking whose business is to receive deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account';
2. 'EEA branches': operating in each EEA country: branches of credit institutions authorised in another EEA country which have the right to passport their activities.
3. 'Non EEA Branches': defined as branches of credit institutions having their Head Office in a third country.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: For legal entities the code should be a valid LEI. For entities without LEI codes the use of RIAD codes is encouraged. If an LEI or RIAD code is not available,	another unique code should be provided by the CA.  For banking groups and liquidity subgroups,	the parent company 'Entity Code' should be used,	if a parent company exists,	otherwise another unique code should be provided. Best practice is to start the non-LEI codes with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country of residence of the entity. This property together with ‘Entity Type’ will form the unique identifier for reporting.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: For legal entities the code should be a valid LEI.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Determines whether the code provided in the 'Entity Code' property is an LEI code or not.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Determines whether the code provided in the 'Entity Code' property is an LEI code or not.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Main code used in NCAs credit registers to identify a credit institution/branch. If the NCA has more than one code,	only the main code shall be reported.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Main code used in NCAs credit registers to identify a credit institution/branch.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Entity name in Latin alphabet. For individual entities this should be the official name as per authorisation of activity (if applicable). For groups the name shall be the one recorded in the NCA’s system, otherwise the one for the parent company. For entities where the official name is not in a Latin based alphabet a transcription into Latin characters should be provided as this property is only based in Latin alphabet,	for harmonisation purposes. Multiple values should be allowed for CRD credit institutions and branches in countries with more than one official national language (e.g. Belgium, Luxembourg). In that case all official names, as per authorisation, shall be recorded (names will be submitted in different/multiple lines) this property will be published in the EBA website in CIR.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Entity name in Latin alphabet.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Entity name in Non-Latin alphabet to be reported for CRD credit institutions and branches that have the official name based in non-Latin alphabet (Cyrillic, Hellenic). This property will be published in the EBA website in CIR.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Institution name in Non-Latin alphabet.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Short name for the entity to be used in EBA statistical publications. Will not be published in CIR.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Short name for the entity to be used in EBA statistical publications. Will not be published in CIR.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyLabel: Type of Undertaking According to CRR Article 27
PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: This information is requested to identify the undertakings that may qualify as a mutual, cooperative society, savings institutions or similar institution for the purposes of art. 27 (1) (a) of the CRR. Each category (“mutual”, “cooperative society”, “savings institution” “similar institution”) are further detailed in Subsection 2 of the RTS on Own Funds (241/2014). For more information regarding subparagraph 27(1)(a)(v) please consult the CRR. The category “Not Applicable” refers to all institution that do not fall under one of the categories explicitly mentioned in Article 27 (1)(a) of the CRR (e.g. 'joint stock companies').
PropertyDefinition.PropertyShortDesc: Type of Undertaking According to CRR Article 27
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc:
This information is requested to identify the undertakings that may qualify as a mutual, cooperative society, savings institutions or similar institution for the purposes of art. 27
 (1) (a) of the CRR. Each category (“mutual”, “cooperative society”, “savings institution” “similar institution”) are further detailed in Subsection 2 of the RTS on Own Funds (241/2014). 
 For more information regarding subparagraph 27(1)(a)(v) please consult the CRR. 
 The category “Not Applicable” refers to all institution that do not fall under one of the categories explicitly mentioned in Article 27 (1)(a) of the CRR (e.g. 'joint stock companies').

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Country of Residence where the entity is geographically located (for branches it refers to the Host Member State/where the branch is established). Fomat: ISO Alpha-2
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Country of Residence where the entity is geographically located (for branches it refers to the Host Member State/where the branch is established

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Town of Residence. For CRD credit institutions should be reported the head office or the registered office (preferably the first but there is flexibility and it is left for the CA to perform this assessment). Regarding branches,	this should be the town where the firm's principal place of business is located (in the host Member State),	or the town "...from which documents may be obtained" (Articles 35 (2) c) & 38 CRD), whatever is available in the NCA’s register. Regarding the language to be provided it should be name in national language(s) (or one of the official national languages), but if a common English name of the town exists it can be used as well. Therefore,	multiple entries are allowed. If name is not in a Latin based alphabet,	then transcription of the name into Latin characters should be provided (if it is available for the CA), while the official name in Non-Latin characters should be reported under property 'Town of Residence Non Latin'.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Town of Residence. For CRD credit institutions should be reported the head office or the registered office

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: This property identifies the CRD credit institutions and branches (EEA and Non-EEA branches) that will be published in the 'active' list of institutions in CIR. Option "yes" is for those institutions which may operate within the EEA and will be published in CIR. Option "no" is for those institutions for which do not possess anymore a valid authorisation and therefore will no longer be published in CIR.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: CRD credit institutions and branches (EEA and Non-EEA branches) that will be published in the 'active' list of institutions in CIR

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Reason for End of Authorisation. To be filled by CRD credit institutions and branches when their authorisation ceased to exist (in property 'CRD Banking Authorisation' have selected option 'No').

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: This property is to provide further details when the reason for why an authorisation ceased was 'National law provision' or 'Other' (in Property 12. 'Reason for End of Authorisation).

PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: This property is to provide further details when the reason for why an authorisation ceased was 'National law provision' or 'Other'

PropertyDefinition.PropertyLabel: Entity Code of the Credit Institution establishing the Branch
PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: This refers to the Code of the entity that established the branch (the code of the branch is reported in property Entity Code and must be different). It is mandatory for EEA branches where it is possible to report LEI codes and Non-LEI codes (the latter only if the Entity that established the branch does not have an LEI). Reporting the attribute for Non-EEA branches is optional and only LEI codes should be reported.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyShortDesc: Entity Code of the Credit Institution establishing the Branch

This refers to the Code of the entity that established the branch (the code of the branch is reported in property Entity Code and must be different). 
It is mandatory for EEA branches where it is possible to report LEI codes and Non-LEI codes (the latter only if the Entity that established the branch does not have an LEI). 
Reporting the attribute for Non-EEA branches is optional and only LEI codes should be reported.

Option 'Non Applicable' refers to situations not covered in art. 12(1) and 12(4) CRD such as credit institutions permanently affiliated to a central body if there is a waiver of the requirements set out in article 12, as foreseen in Article 21 of CRD.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme(s). To be reported by CRD Credit institutions and branches (EEA and Non-EEA) that have a DGS in the host EEA country. For EEA branches it should be reported only the DGS of the host member state (if possible under National Law of host member state). The information regarding the DGS of the credit institution establishing the branch will be derived. For non-EEA branches this should be the EEA host DGS in case of no equivalence as per art. 15 DGSD. In case of equivalence, it means the Non-EEA branch is covered by a third country and therefore that Non-EEA DGS should be reported in property 'Non-EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme'. Please note that even in case of equivalence,	it might be possible/required under National Law of Host MS that the branch is also covered by a local EEA DGS,	in this case then the EEA DGS must also be reported in property 'EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme(s)'.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme(s). To be reported by CRD Credit institutions and branches (EEA and Non-EEA) that have a DGS in the host EEA country.

PropertyDefinition.PropertyDesc: Non-EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme to be reported by non-EEA branches in case of equivalence. If a CA indicates a third country DGS it is presume that this DGS is equivalent with the EEA framework. Please note that non-EEA branches must report at least a DGS in property 'EEA DGS' or in property 'Non-EEA DGS.
PropertyDefinition.PropertyHelpDesc: Non-EEA Deposit Guarantee Scheme to be reported by non-EEA branches in case of equivalence.
